title: Congo Gold Trader Plans Two Refineries with 68-Ton Capacity
excerpt: Democratic Republic of Congo’s state gold trader plans to build two refineries with capacity for 68 tons as the country looks to curb smuggling and profit more from its reserves of the precious metal.

title: Global Stocks Climb as AI Trade Mounts a Comeback: Markets Wrap
excerpt: Stocks rose as investors in Europe and Asia tracked a comeback in technology shares on Wall Street after days of sharp swings.

title: UBS Vows to Remain Global as Swiss Capital Outlook Darkens
excerpt: UBS Group AG’s top leadership sought to reassure staff that Switzerland’s effort to tighten regulation won’t take away something the bank has been building for decades — a truly global business.

title: Brazil Tightens Consumer Lending Rules as Family Debt Soars
excerpt: Brazil’s central bank unveiled measures to curb excessive consumer borrowing as President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva grows concerned about soaring household debt.
